source.origin: Kieso et al. Intermediate Accounting 19e, ch.18 Accounting for Income Taxes, Put It into Practice LO 18.1 'Apply Tax Fundamentals' (book p. 18-14..18-15), Wisco Company
source.ground_truth_provenance: textbook printed solution (Put It into Practice LO 18.1)

prompt: (a) 法人税未払を計算。(b) 法人税費用・繰延税金・未払法人税の仕訳。(c) 損益計算書の税費用区分('税引前利益' から)。(d) DTA の 30% が実現しない可能性が高い(MLTN)場合の評価性引当仕訳。

given.map_note: DeferredTaxAsset and DeferredTaxLiability map to EA's plural canonical titles DeferredTaxAssets and DeferredTaxLiabilities. AllowanceToReduceDeferredTaxAssetToExpectedRealizableValue and the temporary-difference/valuation-allowance logic have no EA counterpart (needs-extension).

expected_output.format_note: Return one JSON object with keys "journal" (one flat posting array combining the part (b) main deferred-tax entry and the part (d) valuation-allowance entry; postings may carry a "part" tag "b"/"d") and "derived" (flat dot-keyed map of the non-journal numeric leaves from parts a/b/c, e.g. "part_a.income_taxes_payable", "part_c.net_income").

review: 全体は判断(part d = MLTN 実現判断), part a-c は一時差異表が定まれば mechanical。主仕訳の貸借 94,000=94,000。EA needs-extension: 累積一時差異からの DTL/DTA 導出・current+deferred の税費用 plug・contra 評価性引当 が builders 外。Reviewer: 純利益 $320,000, part d の $4,200 contra-asset を確認。
confidence: high — part a-d を原本画像 book p.18-14/18-15 で突合。illegible なし。
